julia.peopleops: Hey team — quick policy Q: I had a late checkout at the conference hotel yesterday (flight delayed, checked out 4:05pm). There was a $65 late-checkout fee and a $18 minibar charge (snacks for the squad). How should I file? Is late-checkout pre-approval required? Also, do we prorate per-diem for that travel day or is it full?

mike.finance: Short answer: late-checkout fee can be reimbursed if it was work-related (flight/meeting) or pre-approved by People Ops. Minibar is usually personal, but small shared snack purchases with receipts + attendee list can be considered. For per-diem, we follow first/last day proration rules — see snippet below. Please attach boarding pass + hotel receipt.

mike.finance: ```Per-diem rules:\n- Full day: full per-diem applies for overnight stays.\n- First/Last day: 50% per-diem applies when travel begins/ends on the same calendar day and total travel time < 24 hours.\n- Late-checkout: if checkout is due to company delay (flight, client meeting) and documented, reopen for review; finance/people-ops will adjudicate proration case-by-case.```

sarah.peopleops: To supplement: we do prefer pre-approval for any late checkout > $50. If it was unavoidable (flight cancelled/delayed), retro-approval is OK — manager signoff required. For minibar/team snacks: list names who ate/drank and attach the receipt. If it's obviously personal (single-person minibar items), it won't be reimbursed.

kevin.engineer: I can confirm this was an airline delay (AA 4321). Julia, DM me the receipt link and I'll drop an approval note here.

receipts-bot: receipt uploaded: 1755002000_2025-09-15-hilton-nyc-receipt.pdf

julia.peopleops: Thanks — I'll upload boarding pass + add the attendee list. One more quick Q: if we get approval for the late-checkout fee, do we still apply the usual first/last-day per-diem proration or does the late checkout make the day "full"?

mike.finance: Good question. If the trip includes an overnight stay, we generally treat that calendar day as a full per-diem day unless the travel start/end falls under the 50% rule described above. A late checkout alone doesn't automatically convert a prorated day into a full day — the key is total travel time and overnight status. If this feels borderline, flag it in the expense report and we'll mark as "review - exception approved" once we have manager signoff + boarding pass.

sarah.peopleops: TL;DR: Upload everything (hotel receipt + boarding pass), get manager signoff (kevin said he'll approve), note that the minibar was for the team with names, and we'll approve the $65 if it's due to the AA delay. Julia — ping me when you upload and I'll expedite. :thumbsup:

julia.peopleops: Got it, thanks! Uploading now and will @sarah.peopleops when done. Appreciated. :slightly_smiling_face:
